card.name: Audience blurbs: anyone interested in
card.fires_on: The word for interest or affection (loves, lovers, interested, concerned) right after "anyone who", "all", or "those" in a sentence naming the audience of a book, course or website.

modes.label: Interested in
modes.description: "Interested" or "concerned" after anyone, everyone or those who are, introducing a topic.
modes.example: A useful book for anyone<< interested>> in exploring the psychoanalytic and feminist

modes.label: Lover of a subject
modes.description: Loves or lovers naming people who enjoy a subject such as music, nature or books.
modes.example: attracting thousands of nature<< lovers>> each year.

card.writes: Promotes word endings and starts that continue such audience phrases, with no clear single theme.
card.plain: It spots the phrase that says who a book or site is for, such as anyone interested in or lovers of a subject.
